xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. These results have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standard (referred to as Ind AS) 34 Interim Financial Reporting prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules as amended from time to time. The above Standalone financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors in their respective meetings held on November 14, 2026. The joint statutory auditors have carried out limited review of these financial results.
2. U.P. Government has redetermined levy molasses obligation for the molasses year 2025-26. Financial results for the quarter ending September 30, 2026 are drawn after considering the impact thereof of Rs. 3.23 Crores. Accordingly profit before tax for the quarter and period is lower by Rs 3.23 Crores.
3. The Income Tax Department conducted action under section 132 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 (the Act), at the Company's business premises from October 29 to November 3, 2025. Pursuant to notice under Section 158BC, the Company filed its block return for the period from April 1, 2019 to December 26, 2025, offering additional income of Rs. 18.26 Crores on adhoc basis, without prejudice to its rights and contentions, to mitigate potential financial implications. Since such increase in taxable income is consequent to potential adjustments and do not result into recognition of any assets, no entries are required to be passed in the books of account of the Company at this stage. Tax paid amounting to Rs. 10.17 Crores, net of cash seized and adjusted against tax liability, has been recognised as tax expense relating to earlier years. The Company has sought to claim higher deduction under section 80-IA for FY 2018-19 to FY 2024-25 vide application under Section 119(2)(b), along with manual submission of revised computations. Consequential adjustments, if any, will be considered upon completion of assessment. Based on available records and facts, management believes that conclusion of these proceedings will not materially adversely impact the Company's financial position.
4. Sugar being a seasonal industry, the performance of the quarter may not be representative of the annual performance of the Company.
5. Figures for the previous corresponding periods have been regrouped, wherever considered necessary.
